description: In every PA model, the actual bounded-universal certificate loop is accepted through an internal bound \(n\) when every body test through \(n\) succeeds and the supplied positive builder produces accepted proofs of the tested instances. The body, auxiliary-instance and freshness hypotheses are the stated recognized-syntax conditions.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedUniversalPrograms.forallBoundedBuilder_certified.{u}
  {M : Type u} [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {r : ℕ} (body : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program r)
  (test positive : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program (r + 1)) (x : Fin r → M)
  (hb : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.FixedSyntaxPrograms.FormulaBound 1 (body.value x))
  (hinst :
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.FixedSyntaxPrograms.NamedFormulaBound 0
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.instantiate.value
        ![body.value x,
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 8
            [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M]]))
  (hfresh :
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.occursAux.value

    ∀ (i : M),

  (n : M)
  (hall :
    ∀ (i : M),
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M i n →
        test.value (Fin.snoc x i) = Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.Certified

    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedUniversalPrograms.forallBoundedBuilder
          body positive).value
      (Fin.snoc x n))
    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedUniversalPrograms.boundedCode
          body).value
